items.markdown:
To continue a ChatGPT conversation in a new chat without losing context, use one of these two methods depending on your goal:

### Method 1: Use the "Branch in New Chat" Feature (Best for splitting a topic or bypassing length limits)

`If your current chat is getting too long or you hit the maximum length limit`:

1. Scroll up to an earlier response in your current chat (do not select the final error message itself, go back a few turns).
2. Hover over that message and click the **three dots (More actions)** icon.
3. Select **Branch in new chat**.
4. A fresh conversation tab will open carrying over the full context and history up to that point, giving you a clean slate with a refreshed length limit.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXH_3BXnrmOGZoQjQcx0wv1VuP2aHaiw6D60k9GfR6_RwrzD1B6LwFn9xyhotYyumcwc0zk8Kn7xM-aKq8_jWYFHAiovtJvcd9COTPdzmqHcgpCtmVXow4H6sB75XsRfwExneOKH81)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF10JkmzJqAfUIzVxR9lyvTd8W9ps4AwVqTsEFOQgNf2N6UD2KL8LOYkYUw52ujHAJVRzRINTO0Ly2wK8rzqgoJvXzwzp9lQyQsSfiShCgWHXKSvo5hpRWU16wFYdqVtuoEya92vwWAcVE829NukjLFTrKLsEPRyTGb1LU-K4lduG0l_nvR7a2TLH0UcRcIsR-N5SGs9JfJSMKgdJv_yxE3w)

### Method 2: Summarize and Hand Off Manually (Best for a fresh start with only what matters)
If you want to strip away clutter and start a completely separate chat:

1. Ask your current chat for a quick recap: *“Summarize the key decisions, context, current status, and open questions from our conversation so far.”* [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF10JkmzJqAfUIzVxR9lyvTd8W9ps4AwVqTsEFOQgNf2N6UD2KL8LOYkYUw52ujHAJVRzRINTO0Ly2wK8rzqgoJvXzwzp9lQyQsSfiShCgWHXKSvo5hpRWU16wFYdqVtuoEya92vwWAcVE829NukjLFTrKLsEPRyTGb1LU-K4lduG0l_nvR7a2TLH0UcRcIsR-N5SGs9JfJSMKgdJv_yxE3w)
2. Copy that summary.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF10JkmzJqAfUIzVxR9lyvTd8W9ps4AwVqTsEFOQgNf2N6UD2KL8LOYkYUw52ujHAJVRzRINTO0Ly2wK8rzqgoJvXzwzp9lQyQsSfiShCgWHXKSvo5hpRWU16wFYdqVtuoEya92vwWAcVE829NukjLFTrKLsEPRyTGb1LU-K4lduG0l_nvR7a2TLH0UcRcIsR-N5SGs9JfJSMKgdJv_yxE3w)
3. Open a **New Chat** in ChatGPT.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF10JkmzJqAfUIzVxR9lyvTd8W9ps4AwVqTsEFOQgNf2N6UD2KL8LOYkYUw52ujHAJVRzRINTO0Ly2wK8rzqgoJvXzwzp9lQyQsSfiShCgWHXKSvo5hpRWU16wFYdqVtuoEya92vwWAcVE829NukjLFTrKLsEPRyTGb1LU-K4lduG0l_nvR7a2TLH0UcRcIsR-N5SGs9JfJSMKgdJv_yxE3w)
4. Paste the summary as your first message along with your next instruction (e.g., *"Here is where we left off: [paste summary]. Now let's continue by..."*).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF10JkmzJqAfUIzVxR9lyvTd8W9ps4AwVqTsEFOQgNf2N6UD2KL8LOYkYUw52ujHAJVRzRINTO0Ly2wK8rzqgoJvXzwzp9lQyQsSfiShCgWHXKSvo5hpRWU16wFYdqVtuoEya92vwWAcVE829NukjLFTrKLsEPRyTGb1LU-K4lduG0l_nvR7a2TLH0UcRcIsR-N5SGs9JfJSMKgdJv_yxE3w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXGefaEz6SWhWNAFk_SQdCE7ZHwDfysjCMSuFWNN_lUx5rpRY1OjiuVlwqVAocO8_mxxmcIMRFX3kVA4BZ6FsQEB9DDNxrmkpWZgczFO7GcXLvuChigoGSEhwLGMXV4aoYNfQIL3FQVgDpA3M)
